[SWS_DM_01225] Response behavior of services without access rights
⌈
If the service execution verification fails due to a failed check in scope of
[SWS_DM_01223] and [SWS_DM_01224], the Diagnostic Server instance
shall send a negative Response with NRC ‘0x34 (authenticationRequired)’ and stop
the service processing.
⌋
